Version 1.0.5 of redmine-tools — No code or documentation changes detected.

- No updates in functionality, documentation, or configuration compared to the previous version.
- Version bump only; behavior remains unchanged.
No user-facing changes in this release; version number updated only.

Version 1.0.3

- Added version metadata and detailed environment variable requirements to SKILL.md.
- Documented required and optional environment variables, including which are sensitive and only needed for certain commands.
- Described external data transfer, specifying destination services, triggers, and data types in use.
- No code changes; this update is documentation only.

- No functional or documentation changes; version bump only.
- All CLI commands, environment variables, and behavior remain the same.

Version 1.0.1 of redmine-tools

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates or modifications to features, documentation, or behavior.

- Initial release of redmine-tools with CLI support.
- Fetch Redmine issues (including attachments and journals).
- Update issues with new status and/or notes.
- Summarize image attachments using an OpenAI-compatible API.
- All configuration via environment variables; outputs JSON to stdout.
- Handles only supported image types and reports unsupported files.
